comment: Read from src/Concierge.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The Run jack has 0.1V added before its threshold test (line 510), so it flips at 0.9V rather than the 1V every other jack on this plugin uses. The BPM knob is unlabelled on the panel; the tempo it sets is shown on the display instead. The README says the external clock assumes a quarter note; in the code it simply replaces the fundamental clock, whatever the Quaver knob says that beat is worth. The whole clock tree restarts after 50 cycles of the longest clock (line 229) to keep double-precision phase error from building up, and it restarts whenever either time-signature knob is moved. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
